subject.title: fix(mac): stop Settings crashing on packaged SwiftPM resources

question: Does the macOS packaging owner accept temporary in-place SwiftPM checkout source rewriting as the supported way to repair signed-app resource lookup, given the required cleanup and repeat-build guarantees?
rationale: The workaround resolves a real signed-app boundary but changes a reusable dependency-build workspace; code review can verify mechanics, while accepting this packaging ownership and operational tradeoff requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the bounded packaging workaround
options.body: Merge after confirming cleanup and repeat-build behavior on the supported macOS packaging environments.

options.title: Require an upstream or build-setting alternative
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw packaging to rewrite dependency sources during assembly.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded packaging workaround
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming cleanup and repeat-build behavior on the supported macOS packaging environments.
